_meta.rank_rule: a work already served from a better source per the precedence ladder (First1KGreek/Perseus TEI, byzantium.gr manual transcription) is carved to data/corpus_secondary/ with rank secondary, never as a competing primary
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary goes to exactly one work, normally the later work when the row carries its incipit/heading, the earlier work when the following work's text only starts on the next row; each decision is recorded in the work notes
_meta.slug_policy: works with a TLG id use the slug the source registry / crosswalk already holds for that id (the canon-derived house naming); a canon-gap TLG id (tlg2866.tlg002, empty canon title) gets a curated slug on the sibling-work pattern, the lettered_subedition_slugs.json precedent. Works without any TLG id get author.title slugs under the repo's established author slugs (theophylactus-achridensis, michael-psellus, symeon-thessalonicensis, leo-vi-sapiens, procopius-rhetoric, photius, oecumenius, ...), minting new author slugs only where none exists (tiberianus, quadratus-apologeta, pantaenus, rhodon, basilius-i-macedo, constantinus-siculus, demetrius-cydones, joannes-diaconus-hadrianopolitanus, esaias-cyprius, hilarion-monachus, theodorus-agallianus, josephus-ii-patriarcha, job-monachus, and the anonymous-work authors laudatio-sancti-demetrii, vita-basilii-iunioris, anonymus-de-vita-mohammedis)

volumes.residual_note:
Two blocks, and what each one IS is settled from its own bytes; who wrote either is not. 13-89 is a set of Marian homilies: ΛΟΓΟΣ Αʹ at 13 εἰς τὴν γέννησιν τῆς ... Θεοτόκου, ΛΟΓΟΣ Γʹ at 43 εἰς τὸν Εὐαγγελισμὸν τῆς ... Θεοτόκου, each closing on a doxology. 92-118 is a dialogue that states its own purpose in a ΠΡΟΟΙΜΙΟΝ at 92: συζήτησις ... περὶ τῆς τοῦ ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἐκπορεύσεως, καὶ λύσις τῆς μέσον ἡμῶν καὶ τῶν Λατίνων ἀμφιβολίας, ὁ δὲ χαρακτὴρ διαλογικός, with ΓΡ./ΛΑΤ. speaker tags through 118, where it closes on Athanasius, Cyril and the Damascene.

Neither is carved, and the reason is specific rather than 'not researched'. scripts/scan_display_heads.py over 13-118 returns ZERO display heads in either script: the only all-caps words surviving in 104 rows are ΛΟΓΟΣ three times, ΠΡΟΟΙΜΙΟΝ once and a ΛΑΤ speaker tag. Migne prints running heads that name the author, as PG151 and PG113 both show, and this OCR dropped every one of them here. So there is no handle in our bytes at all, and the vendored TLG Canon holds no record for either candidate the volume's collective label names, which is why the Joel carve could lean on a word count and these cannot. Attribution needs the PG 139 page images.

554-558 is a table of contents, not a work, and it belongs to neither block: it lists the 25+ τόμοι of a heresiology running from Adam and the Greek mysteries through the councils to a dogma under Manuel, whose text continues beyond this volume.

works.evidence: 77 rows, 24,029 tokens. The running head over these columns reads ISIDORI THESSALONICENSIS, checked at two widely separated points: columns 39-40, whose Greek is verbatim our locus 27 (Πάσαις τοίνυν ψήφοις ἄφθαρτος ἡ πανύμνητος), and columns 135-136, verbatim our locus 75. Column 17-18 carries the per-sermon head SERMO IN NATIVITATEM B. V. MARIAE. The collection is Marian throughout: ΛΟΓΟΣ Αʹ at 13 εἰς τὴν γέννησιν τῆς Θεοτόκου, ΛΟΓΟΣ Βʹ at column 40 εἰς τὴν εἰς τὰ Ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων εἴσοδον, ΛΟΓΟΣ Γʹ at 43 εἰς τὸν Εὐαγγελισμόν, which is where the title comes from; Migne prints no single title over the set. No TLG anchor: the vendored Canon has no record for this Isidore. Migne's own running head, read off the page scan (Internet Archive item patrologia.graeca.org, file _139.zip, page PNGs). Our loci map to Migne columns as col = 2*locus - 14, pinned on two independent text matches: our locus 27 is column 40 and our locus 75 is column 136, and locus 93 is column 172.
